explanation: Pick the spoon and place it inside the tub container, unless it is already inside.
author: wonder
diff_from_parent:
--- v0.py
+++ v1.py
@@ -0,0 +1,15 @@
+def run(scene, robot):
+    spoons = scene.of_kind("spoon")
+    if spoons:
+        spoon = spoons[0]
+    else:
+        spoon = scene.with_role("moved")[0]
+    tubs = scene.containers()
+    if tubs:
+        tub = tubs[0]
+    else:
+        tub = scene.of_kind("tub")[0]
+    if scene.is_inside(spoon, tub):
+        return
+    robot.pick(spoon)
+    robot.place_in(tub)
